items.headline: Big Tech stocks lift Wall Street as Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD and Micron advance
items.summary: Nvidia rose 2.8%, Broadcom 3%, AMD 5.4% and Micron 1.9% as AI-related stocks rebounded, while market participants remained concerned about elevated AI valuations.

items.headline: Apple shares fall as higher memory-chip costs pressure expected margins
items.summary: Apple shares declined after the company indicated that higher memory-chip expenses linked to AI data-center demand would reduce profit per dollar of revenue in the final quarter of 2026.

items.headline: Palantir falls despite better-than-expected profit and strong commercial growth
items.summary: Palantir declined even after reporting better-than-expected profit; U.S. commercial revenue increased 148% year over year and exceeded U.S. government revenue for the first time.

items.headline: AI infrastructure shares lead midday trade ahead of AMD earnings
items.summary: Oracle gained 6% as investors positioned for AMD's earnings, with the market focused on data-center demand and whether the AI-led rally could continue.

items.headline: Apple-linked margin concerns overshadow Amazon in distributor-contract dispute
items.summary: Apple declined as investors focused on memory-cost pressure and a reported Spanish antitrust sanction; Amazon was little changed, suggesting the market viewed the issue as primarily Apple-specific.
items.tag: Big Tech regulatory and margin risk

items.headline: Financial leaders warn AI investment boom requires more capital and carries correction risk
items.summary: Reuters reported that technology companies may need additional capital to meet AI demand, while executives and financial leaders warned that high valuations, financing needs and uncertainty could increase volatility.
